//: Dedicated typecheck gate: `npm run typecheck`. Covers the TS surface (app/, server/), which the
base tsconfig.json does not fully check (it excludes server/). The Supabase-touching .mjs files
carry typed-client @type annotations (guardrails: invented tables/columns light up in-editor
and at the app/actions.ts <Database> write path); they are intentionally NOT blanket-@ts-checked
because jsonb columns generate as opaque `Json` and the tenant-isolation seam takes a runtime
table name, so full checkJs there is 100+ non-schema errors, not real bugs. Runtime invented-
data safety is enforced by the Zod schemas in lib/schemas/. Not used by `next build`.
